title: Mask Adoption Dynamics Simulation
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads, persists, or declines in a population under social influence, policies, information campaigns, and access constraints.

interactions.name: peer_influence
interactions.description: Individuals update mask-wearing propensity based on the behavior of their social contacts (social contagion).

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Locations enforce mask policies, affecting individual compliance through penalties or access control.

interactions.name: information_dissemination
interactions.description: Information sources broadcast messages that shape risk perception and trust, influencing adoption decisions.

interactions.name: mask_acquisition
interactions.description: Individuals purchase or obtain masks subject to retailer stock, price, and rationing.

interactions.name: policy_updates
interactions.description: Policy makers adjust mask mandates and guidance based on epidemic indicators or adoption rates.

interactions.name: disease_exposure_feedback
interactions.description: Local disease prevalence affects risk perception and subsequent mask adoption (optional disease module).

metrics.name: overall_adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Proportion of the population wearing masks at each timestep.

metrics.name: time_to_threshold_adoption
metrics.description: Timesteps required to reach a specified adoption level (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: adoption_by_group
metrics.description: Adoption rates segmented by demographic or attitudinal groups (e.g., age, risk level, political identity).

metrics.name: compliance_in_policy_locations
metrics.description: Average mask-wearing compliance when entering locations with mandates.

metrics.name: abandonment_rate
metrics.description: Rate at which adopters stop wearing masks per timestep.

metrics.name: policy_impact_effect_size
metrics.description: Difference in adoption/compliance attributable to policy changes, controlling for other factors.

metrics.name: mask_access_inequity_index
metrics.description: Inequity of mask access across income groups (e.g., Gini coefficient of access_to_masks).

metrics.name: infection_rate_reduction
metrics.description: Change in infection incidence compared to a counterfactual without masks (if disease module enabled).
